# Fix broken Star History Chart in README

## What
Repair or replace the Star History chart embed in `README.md` that currently shows "GitHub restricted access to star data" instead of a star-growth chart.

## Why
The Star History section at the bottom of the public README is broken and looks unprofessional to visitors. GitHub's stargazer API restriction causes `api.star-history.com` to return a placeholder SVG (`x-chart-status: restricted`) rather than actual chart data.

## Where
work_dir: /Users/Swapnil/workspace/swapnil/OpenSRE

## Done when
- Star History section in `README.md` displays a working chart on GitHub (light and dark mode), **or** is intentionally replaced/removed with a documented alternative.
- GitHub issue #23 is closed or updated with the chosen fix.

## Out of scope
- Broader README redesign.
- Other badge/chart sections (shields.io stars badge in header is separate and still works).

## Open questions
- Can repo-owner restoration via star-history.com restore the dynamic embed?
- Static committed image vs. alternative chart service vs. removal — which is preferred?

## Tracking
- GitHub issue: https://github.com/swapnildahiphale/OpenSRE/issues/23

---
*Before you start on this task, read CLAUDE.md in the work_dir and any
nested CLAUDE.md files in the subtree you plan to modify. Then read
every file under `updates/` (if any exist) to catch up on prior
progress.*
